scope: Selected A1.3-relevant, visually checked source activities and numbered responses. This is source mapping, not copied web question content or an independently verified answer key.
itemizationLimit: An activity_or_subactivity record is not proof that the page contains only one answer. Only response_identified records isolate a response slot. Internal table/group labels are indexing aids, not printed exercise numbers.
publisherAnswerKeyStatus: Publisher key locations and per-record review states are in a13-publisher-key-review.json. The supplied Kursbuch excerpt lacks its referenced solutions page 105; Hueber publishes separate Kursbuch and Arbeitsbuch keys online.

decisionLegend.in_scope: The underlying skill matches the lesson; write original web content and verify answers before publication.
decisionLegend.partial: Only named slots or part of the mechanic match; filter prerequisites and difficulty.
decisionLegend.adapt: The activity skill fits another practice category; replace source wording and assets.
decisionLegend.review_only: Useful as review or reference, not a main target item for this lesson.
decisionLegend.asset_required: Requires new audio, art, or an assessment method before a web exercise exists.
decisionLegend.exclude_level: The publisher labels the exercise A2, or it adds a higher-level skill.
decisionLegend.worked_example: The book prints this response as a model; do not count it as a fresh task.
